title: 第11章 升级魔法减伤第12章 霍仙儿与地苍龙
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
“叮！
灵宠血幽成功消灭一个骷髅兵（220）。”
“叮！
灵宠血幽成功消灭一个骷髅兵（320）。”
……
一共消灭了六个骷髅兵，叶凌的任务几乎已经完成了三分之一。
已经尝到了甜头，这种时候自然是趁热打铁。
不过，为了自己的安全问题，叶凌并没有前往更深处。
自己完全可以先清除外围的骷髅兵，完成任务从而提升血幽的等级。
没必要以身犯险。
至少，在血幽还没有成长到足够强大之前，叶凌需要慢慢来。
于是接下来的时间，就变成了愉快的骷髅兵清除活动。
沿着外围走，时不时的就能够遇上一组骷髅兵，甚至是两组。
但是都无一例外，全部都被血幽给轻轻松松的解决掉了。
仅仅不到半个小时后，叶凌所得到的系统任务就已经完成了。
“叮！
首战完成，成功击杀二十个骷髅兵，奖励灵宠血幽当前经验值百分之五十进度。”
本身消灭二十的骷髅兵，就带来了百分之十的经验值进度，完成任务后又再加百分之五十。
也就是说这一下，直接就有了百分之六十的进度条
如果接下来没有任务，只需要再击杀八十个骷髅兵，血幽就能够再次提升等级。

这升级速度，简直就和坐了火箭一样，蹭蹭蹭的上涨。
而且最重要的是，叶凌发现了一件事情。
那就是……血幽并没有体力的限制。
即使是经过这几次战斗，叶凌都没有看到血幽任何一点慌张，亦或者是体力降低的情况。
“难道是说……是因为僵尸的缘故吗？”
回想起来，叶凌还记得自己前世里面所了解到的。
僵尸，是一种不老不死，无法堕入轮回的特殊存在。
同样不仅如此，僵尸拥有了无限的精力，不管是做什么活，都可以不知疲倦的做下去。
要知道，之前选择天赋超速再生的时候，叶凌可是清楚的记得。
需要消耗体力，才能够恢复身体受的伤。
而本身僵尸的体力就是无限的，这算不算是一个Bug？
content_en:
“Ding!
The spiritual pet Xueyou successfully destroyed a skeleton soldier (220). "
“Ding!
The spiritual pet Xueyou successfully destroyed a skeleton soldier (320). "
…
A total of six skeleton soldiers were eliminated, and Ye Ling had almost completed one-third of his mission.
Having already tasted the sweetness, it is natural to strike while the iron is hot at this time.
However, for his own safety, Ye Ling did not go deeper.
You can completely clear out the skeleton soldiers on the periphery first, complete the task and improve the level of Xueyou.
There is no need to put yourself at risk.
At least, Ye Ling needs to take his time before Xueyou grows strong enough.
So the next time turned into a pleasant skeleton soldier clearing activity.
Walking along the perimeter, you can encounter a group of skeleton soldiers from time to time, or even two groups.
But without exception, they were all easily solved by Xue You.
Less than half an hour later, Ye Ling's system task was completed.
“Ding!
The first battle is completed, and twenty skeleton soldiers are successfully killed, and the spirit pet Xueyou will be rewarded with 50% progress in the current experience value. "
Killing 20 skeleton soldiers by itself will bring 10% experience value progress, and after completing the task, another 50% will be added.
In other words, this time, there is a 60% progress bar.
If there is no mission next, he only needs to kill eighty more skeleton soldiers, and Xue You can level up again.
This upgrade speed is just like riding a rocket, rising slowly.
And most importantly, Ye Ling discovered something.
That is... Xueyou has no physical limitations.
Even after these few battles, Ye Ling did not see any panic or loss of physical strength in Xueyou.
"Could it be that... it's because of the zombies?"
Looking back, Ye Ling still remembered what he learned in his previous life.
Zombies are special beings that are immortal and unable to fall into reincarnation.
Also not only that, zombies have unlimited energy and can continue to do it tirelessly no matter what kind of work they are doing.
You know, Ye Ling clearly remembered when he chose the talent of super-speed regeneration before.
It takes physical exertion to recover from the injuries sustained by the body.
And the physical strength of zombies is unlimited. Is this a bug?
